source_evidence: if you are saving for a short-term goal, five years or less, you don’t want to choose risky investments, because when it’s time to sell, you may have to take a loss.
question: Misconception: Risky investments are fine for a goal that is five years away or sooner, because you can simply sell when you need the money.
answer: For a short-term goal of five years or less, a risky investment could leave you taking a loss when it is time to sell. The source advises against choosing risky investments for this kind of goal.
